Acts of piracy and armed robbery allegedly committed against ships reported by
Member States or international organizations in consultative status
Details of the incident Consequences for 
crew, ship, cargo Coastal State Action Taken
While underway, a tanker was boarded and hijacked by 
pirates. The tanker appears to be sailing towards Somalia. 
Authorities are investigating.
Pirates took hostage 22 
crew members and 
hijacked the tanker
Authorities are monitoring the 
tanker
* * *
Duty crew onboard a ship underway noticed a skiff with 
armed pirates approaching. Seeing the threat, master 
stopped the vessel, activated the distress alert, switched on 
the AIS and instructed all crew to retreat to the citadel. After 
a while, the crew exited the citadel. While no pirates were 
seen, the crew noticed the boarding ladders still rigged to 
the ship side resulting in the crew returning to the citadel as 
precaution. The Master's assessment indicated that four 
pirates had boarded the ship and later departed. All crew 
reported safe.

Duty crew on board an anchored ship noticed ropes and a 
hook on the quarter deck and two unauthorised persons in 
the engine room. Alarm raised resulting in the unauthorised 
persons escaping with stolen engine spares. The incident was 
reported to Jakarta VTS and local agent.
